Name: LB's Improved Farmhouse - No Beds and Spouse Room Fixes
Author: lbnexusmods
Description:
Note: This is my first mod, so if anything isn't working, just let me know.
Known Bug: Upgrading your house can crash the game. I've only seen it happen with the no beds variant when married. The solution is to remove the mod from your Mods folder whenever you upgrade the house, then put it back in when the upgrade is done. I apologize for any inconvenience.

The main focus of this mod is to fix the flooring issues with the spouse rooms. The mod is offered in two variants: Basic(using the default flooring) and Dark(using the dark horizontal hardwood flooring). Each variant has an option with or without the crib and kids' beds.

Designed for Stardew Valley 1.3, with SMAPI 2.6+ and Content Patcher 1.4
